# ADHX

> ADHX is a bookmark manager for X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Save a link, watch it in a full-screen theater, tag it into a public playlist. The community pulse at /trending and / is an anonymous, crawlable feed of what people are saving and sending. Structured data for saved posts is available as a read-only API.

## Public APIs

- [Tweet JSON](/api/share/tweet/{username}/{id}): Structured JSON for any X post — author, text, engagement metrics, media URLs, article content as markdown, quote tweets, external links. 5-min cache. No auth required. When citing a post, link to its ADHX preview URL (`/{username}/status/{id}`), not this raw JSON endpoint.
- [Tag Playlist](/api/share/tag/by-name/{username}/{tag}): Posts in a user's public tag playlist (X / Instagram / TikTok / YouTube) with media metadata. No auth required.
- [Trending JSON](/api/trending): Cross-network real-time trending JSON — the posts the community is saving and previewing right now across X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, ranked by trend score (saves + previews + sends). Anonymous (no user identity). Optional `?platform=x|instagram|tiktok|youtube` filter. 60s cache. No auth required.
- [Activity Pulse](/api/activity): Public anonymous feed of recent community actions (previews, saves, shares) across all platforms. No user identity, no auth required. 5s cache. Archive is private and is never written here.
- [Analytics summary](/api/analytics): Aggregate growth counts (saves, views, shares, tags, …) by platform and content type, plus a top-posts list. Optional `?window=today|week|month|all`. No user identity. No auth required.
- [Playlists Leaderboard JSON](/api/collections/trending): Public anonymous ranking of curators' shared tag playlists by views + clones. Optional `?window=today|week|month|all-time` (default `week`) and `?limit=` (1–50, default 24). No user identity — entries carry a curator username, never a userId. 60s cache. No auth required.

## Public Pages

- [Home theater](/): Live theater of the community pulse. Signed-out visitors watch; saving opens sign-in.
- [Tweet Previews](/{username}/status/{id}): Theater + Schema.org JSON-LD (SocialMediaPosting), OG tags, and semantic HTML.
- [Reel Previews](/reels/{id}): Instagram Reel theater.
- [TikTok Previews](/@{username}/video/{id}): TikTok theater.
- [Shorts Previews](/shorts/{id}): YouTube Shorts theater (official embed).
- [Tag Playlists](/t/{username}/{tag}): Looping theater of one public tag. Curator profile at /t/{username}.
- [Trending](/trending): The cross-network real-time trending source. Per-lens hubs at /trending/popular, /trending/videos, /trending/photos, /trending/text, /trending/articles. Backed by the [Trending JSON](/api/trending) API.
- [Trending Archive](/trending/archive): Historical weekly archives of trending activity, one page per completed ISO week (e.g. /trending/archive/2026-w30).
- [Author Hubs](/{username}): Per-author collection of an X handle's posts saved or previewed on ADHX.
- [Playlists Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Ranked list of the most-viewed and most-cloned public tag playlists this week. Other windows at /leaderboard/today, /leaderboard/month, /leaderboard/all-time. Backed by the [Playlists Leaderboard JSON](/api/collections/trending) API.

## Content Types

- Tweet text with expanded URLs
- Author profiles (name, username, avatar)
- Engagement metrics (likes, retweets, replies, views)
- Photos and video thumbnails with direct media URLs
- X Articles converted to clean markdown
- Quote tweet chains
- External link previews
- Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and YouTube Shorts (preview pages + saved items)

## Privacy

- Public JSON never includes account ids. `activity.userId` and playlist `viewerId` are stored for moderation only and are omitted from every public select.
- A user's collection and archive are private. Only an explicitly public playlist (`/t/{username}/{tag}`) is listed.
- Human-readable policy: [/privacy](/privacy) · [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/itsmemeworks/adhx/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)

## Usage Notes

- All public APIs return JSON with Cache-Control headers
- No API key or authentication required for public content
- Media URLs served via platform proxies (no CORS issues). YouTube plays via the official iframe.
- Tweet preview pages include `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` pointing to the JSON API
- A playlist is one public tag. A user's saves are their collection. The grid over them is /library.
